articles.summary: Tinfoil is a private AI platform that runs inference, fine-tuning, and AI agent workloads inside secure hardware enclaves so no one, not even Tinfoil, can access sensitive user data.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ To enable this, Tinfoil requires secure hardware features only available in select modern GPUs and CPUs, as well as specific firmwares and BIOS configurations. By working with Shadeform, Tinfoil can easily access machines with these uncommon specs at scale through a single platform, rather than hunting down small allocations across individual providers.
articles.title: How Tinfoil sources confidential computing infrastructure 15x faster with Shadeform
